title: Get Lowpoly Working End to End
description: Fix lowpoly plugin build and get it working end to end. Compile error: WindowMeasure::Slider missing fields `loading` and `ready` in lowpoly/plugin/rs/lib.rs. Dev command `dev:lowpoly` fails during plugin build.
summary: Lowpoly plugin failed to compile after UiInspectorFieldGroup gained a required `presence` field (unified UI element state model). Added `presence: UiPresence::default()` to the object inspector group in lowpoly/plugin/rs/lib.rs. Verified: `cargo build -p lowpoly-plugin --target wasm32-wasip2 --release` succeeds; `SEMIO_RENDERER=react bun run dev:lowpoly` serves at http://127.0.0.1:6078/; Playwright boot shows title `semio · lowpoly`, canvas present, Edit/Paint chrome, Document/Catalogue/Layers/Inspection panels, and no page errors.

interactions.author: Ueli Saluz <ueli@semio-tech.com>
interactions.prompt: Get lowpoly plugin working end to end using maximum four concurrent GPT 6.1 Sol agents. Preserve concurrent work and verify complete workflows.
